servicesSummary: H.Q. Energy Services (U.S.), Inc. During this reporting period, Blaze concluded its relationship with H.Q. Energy Services. This involved wrap up meetings, reviews of work completed in prior reporting periods and general closure of our business together.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $83,922.51 in total disbursements for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
extractionMethod: Text of the original DOJ FARA supplemental filing; source-verified structured extraction
coverage: Registrant-level filing totals are reported only when the form provides an explicit total.
